summary: Security audit of the earshot sound-set track at reduced scope. The pip pin is an exact 40-character commit, set-name and entry-name validation with /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ runs before any path is built and blocks traversal, the child binary spawns with an argv array and no shell, EARSHOT_BIN is X_OK-checked, SOUNDS_ROOT only relocates a user-controlled root, the venv is gitignored with no secret or large binary committed, sound-setup.sh quoting and interpreter fallback are safe, and failed renders leak no child output. A2 is not applicable (no publish transition) and A6 holds (registry says in_progress; all seven committed Ogg files independently pass the nine AC3 header steps). Two low-severity nonblocking notes: unpinned transitive pip dependencies, and the venv deletion on each re-create attempt.
nonblocking_findings: F1 (low): transitive pip dependencies resolve from PyPI unpinned; only the earshot package is commit-pinned, so a changed upstream release could alter the venv. Fix (optional): record pip freeze output after install or install with --no-deps plus an explicit dependency list.

F2 (low): sound-setup.sh runs 'rm -rf .venv-earshot' before each interpreter candidate, deleting a prior working venv on a failed re-run; the path is a literal in the repo root and not exploitable. Fix (optional): delete the venv only after a candidate succeeds.
evidence: scripts/sound-setup.sh:23 installs 'earshot @ git+https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot@7a7f7c5c70d4a763a1eca4b3666af7c77e313f97', an exact commit, not a branch or tag; sounds/README.md names the same pin.

scripts/sound-set.mjs:14 defines SAFE_NAME /^[a-z0-9-]+$/; line 23 validates the set name before any path is built at line 25; entry names are validated at line 49 before join() at line 69; tests/sound-set.test.ts:188-195 proves the '../x' rejection.
scripts/sound-set.mjs:70 spawnSync(earshot, ['make', '--sound', design, '-o', out]) uses an argv array with no shell; set JSON name and design cannot inject.
scripts/sound-set.mjs:58-63 resolves EARSHOT_BIN and checks it with accessSync X_OK before use; SOUNDS_ROOT at line 13 only relocates a root the invoking user controls.

.gitignore adds .venv-earshot/; git ls-files under sounds/ shows only README.md, sets/chibi.json, and the seven .ogg files; no venv, secret, or large binary is committed; the seven Ogg files total about 90 KB.
scripts/sound-setup.sh runs under set -euo pipefail with quoted expansions, an empty-PYTHON guard, a literal rm -rf path, and the fallback order PYTHON, python3, python3.12, python3.11.
Every failure path prints exactly one stderr line and exits via fail(); a failed render's captured child output is never forwarded (scripts/sound-set.mjs:70-77).

A2 not applicable: no draft-to-published transition exists in this track. A6 holds: measure/tracks.md and metadata.json say in_progress, not resolved, and plan claims align with red.log and green.log evidence.
Independent node one-liner check confirmed all seven committed Ogg files pass the nine AC3 header steps (OggS, version 0, BOS flag, vorbis id packet, stereo, 48000 Hz, framing flag 1).
git rev-parse HEAD equals c86ccebe6ba5a72b388ca3118f5159875675597e, the audited_head_sha; unrelated uncommitted changes in the working tree are outside the audited diff.
